note: The private half of tests/data/mapmaker_focus_browser_mutants.json (tools/mutate.py runs it together with the public half): the mutants of files that are not in the public repository, and the ones that only a test that is not there catches. Mutants of the typing in the map maker's boxes, judged by the REAL browser, for tools/mutate.py (docs/TESTING.md, 'Mutation checks'): the same broken copies as tests/data/mapmaker_focus_mutants.json that the browser can notice (a box taken out of the page loses the focus, a caret that is not put back), against tests/scripts/web_mapmaker_focus_browser.py --strict, which needs a Chromium-based browser (CHROME=/path/to/it). Run by hand from the checkout: tools/mutate.py tests/data/mapmaker_focus_browser_mutants.json --keep-going --jobs 1; every mutant must be caught.
